title: From Handcrafted to Generative: RLVR-Optimized Icon Generation for Alexa+
abstract: arXiv:2611.06123v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Alexa+ devices with screens display animated icons during conversations to visually reinforce what is being said. The original set of these icons was hand-drawn by designers one at a time, a process that produces polished results but is time-consuming and cannot scale to the range of topics encountered in open-ended conversation. We describe an automated pipeline, deployed in production, that generates these vectorised animated icons from a text description alone and surfaces relevant animations to customers based on their ongoing conversation. The pipeline decomposes icon creation into a sequence of stages (image generation, semantic decomposition, vectorisation, styling, and animation). Its quality is determined at the very first of these, image generation, on which every downstream stage depends. We therefore focus on improving this first and most critical stage. translated_title: 从手工绘制到生成式：面向 Alexa+ 的 RLVR 优化图标生成
translated_abstract: 配备屏幕的 Alexa+ 设备会在对话过程中显示动态图标，以视觉方式强化所表达的内容。最初的这批图标由设计师逐个手工绘制，这种方式虽能产出精美的成果，但耗时且无法扩展至开放式对话中遇到的各种话题。我们描述了一条已部署于生产环境的自动化流水线，它能够仅凭文本描述生成这些矢量化动态图标，并根据用户正在进行的对话向其展示相关的动画。该流水线将图标创建分解为一系列阶段（图像生成、语义分解、矢量化、样式化和动画制作）。其质量在最前面的图像生成阶段就被决定，所有下游阶段都依赖于这一阶段。因此，我们专注于改进这一首要且最关键的阶段。由于这些图标需要在严格的设计约束下在小尺寸显示画布上渲染……
tldr: 该论文提出并部署了一套仅凭文本描述自动生成矢量化动画图标的生产级流水线，并将图标创建分解为多个阶段，重点利用 RLVR（可验证奖励的强化学习）优化其中决定整体质量的最关键阶段——图像生成，从而解决手工绘制图标耗时且难以规模化的问题。
en_tdlr: The paper presents a production-deployed automated pipeline that generates vectorized animated icons for Alexa+ from text descriptions alone, decomposing icon creation into staged steps and focusing on RLVR-optimized image generation as the most critical, quality-determining first stage.
